stem.en: Is each statement true or false?

text.en: A word has one fixed embedding, but each picture gets its own latent code from the encoder.
The decoder opens a latent code into pixels without using an embedding table.
A person chose what each of the 16,384 numbers in a latent code should mean.
Any list of 16,384 random numbers opens into a clear picture.

explanation.en: Embeddings sit in a fixed table, while latent codes are worked out for each picture and open straight into pixels. Training found the numbers in a latent code, so they have no names, and random latent codes open into speckle.

hints.en: Think back to what you saw when you pressed Open on a random latent code.
